name: BACH_0081
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (98%)** · Confident · Careful review
Tier-2 priority for invasive prediction [F1] with CONCH–MUSK agreement, though 3 of 5 similar cases are InSitu [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 98%, InSitu 2%, Benign 0%, Normal 0% | Strong invasive score; 5% dataset ECE |
| Conformal set | Invasive (90% target; 90% test coverage) | Single class at dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 88th OOD percentile, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input; 70% error AUROC |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent foundation models agree |
| Similar cases | 40% match (2/5 Invasive, 3/5 InSitu) | Closest neighbor BACH_0241 (90%) InSitu |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 6, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical embedding score (+0.74 contribution) [F2]; AI spot check 19/20 · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 7) · context · Below-typical embedding score (+0.62 contribution) [F3]; AI spot check 8/20 · Weak
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 5, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.36 contribution), caption-inconsistent [F4]; AI spot check 18/20 · Weak
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Low score pushes toward invasion (+0.34); AI spot check 0/20 · Unreliable
- **Immune cells near tumor** (regions 0, 2, 10) · context · 92nd reference percentile [F7], from 2 inflammatory nuclei counted · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; deleting top 3 risk regions drops score beyond random (95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088 to +0.0064 spans 0); normal lobules (0/20), mitoses (0/20), necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Apparent stromal infiltration in regions 6, 10, 11 is actually InSitu, matching closest neighbor BACH_0241 (90% similarity).
- Prominent tubules in regions 5, 8, 9 reflect non-invasive ducts rather than well-differentiated invasive carcinoma.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 6, 10, 11 (and 0, 2)**: Confirm stromal invasion (94%–99% risk) before signing drafted ER/PR/HER2/Ki-67 orders.
2. **Regions 5, 8, 9**: Inspect gland/tubule formations to distinguish well-differentiated invasive tubules from InSitu carcinoma.
3. **Region 7**: Check lymphocytes directly; ignore unreliable necrosis (3/20) and mitoses (0/20) concept scores.
